title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
text: vignette demonstrates typical workflow differential expression, GO -representation analysis (GO-ORA), pathway overlap network generation, pathway module interpretation using GDSCtools. workflow includes: Differential expression analysis GO enrichment analysis Pathway overlap network construction Leiden clustering GO pathways Word cloud generation Extraction biologically related GO modules

title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
code: library(GDSCtools) library(org.Mm.eg.db)

title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
text: workflow assumes Seurat object named seurat_obj containing single-cell RNA-seq data. identities compared example : Car Bleo across selected fibroblast clusters.

title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
text: Run differential expression analysis across selected clusters. Write differential expression results disk.
code: de_results <- run_cluster_de(   obj        = seurat_obj,   clusters   = c("Fibroblast 1", "Fibroblast 2"),   cluster_col = "final_celltypes",   ident1     = "Car",   ident2     = "Bleo" ) write_de_results(   de_results,   outSubDir = "results/DE/",   type = "DE",   split_direction = FALSE )

title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
text: Define gene universe. Run GO enrichment analysis using Biological Process ontology save results. Export GO enrichment results.
code: universe <- rownames(seurat_obj) go_results <- run_go_ora(   de_list   = de_results,   org_db    = org.Mm.eg.db,   universe  = universe,   ont       = "BP",   outputDir = "results/GO/" ) write_de_results(   go_results,   outSubDir = "results/GO/",   type = "GO",   split_direction = FALSE )

title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
text: Generate pathway overlap networks GO enrichment results. function automatically generate folder called “network/” base_outdir resulting networks: represent GO terms nodes, connect pathways sharing DE genes, cluster pathways using Leiden community detection, identify higher-order biological programs.
code: net_results <- run_comparison_networks(   go_list     = go_results,   de_list     = de_results,   comp_label  = "Car_vs_Bleo",   base_outdir = "results/" )

title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
text: Export GO terms associated Leiden clusters. baked function yet.
code: for (i in names(net_results)) {    x <- net_results[[i]]$go_term_df    cluster <- gsub("/", "_", i)    name <- paste0(cluster, "_cluster_membership.csv")    write.csv(     x,     file = paste0(       outputDir,       "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo/networks/",       name     )   ) }

title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
text: Generate cluster-specific pathway word clouds. word clouds summarize dominant biological themes within Leiden pathway module.
code: write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork(   net_list   = net_results,   outputDir  = "results/",   comparison = "Car_vs_Bleo" )

title: GO-ORA Network Analysis Workflow
text: Extract GO terms belonging Leiden cluster target GO term. example, extracellular matrix organization module: can help identify coordinated biological programs.
code: ecm_terms <- write_cluster_results(   net_result = net_results[["Fibroblast_1"]],   go_term    = "extracellular matrix organization",   outdir     = "results/Car_vs_Bleo/networks/" )

title: Genomic Data Science Utilities for the Genomic Data Science Core
text: CRAN: igraph, dplyr, ggplot2, ggwordcloud, patchwork, scales, stringr Bioconductor: Seurat, clusterProfiler, org.Mm.eg.db (org.Hs.eg.db) Install Bioconductor dependencies first needed:

title: Genomic Data Science Utilities for the Genomic Data Science Core
code: library(GDSCUtils) library(org.Mm.eg.db)  # 1. Differential expression de_results <- run_cluster_de(   obj        = seurat_obj,   clusters   = c("Fibroblast 1", "Fibroblast 2"),   ident1     = "Car",   ident2     = "Bleo" )  write_de_results(de_results, outSubDir = "results/DE/", type = "DE")  # 2. GO enrichment universe <- rownames(seurat_obj)  go_results <- run_go_ora(   de_list   = de_results,   org_db    = org.Mm.eg.db,   universe  = universe,   ont       = "BP",   outputDir = "results/GO/" )  write_de_results(go_results, outSubDir = "results/GO/", type = "GO",                  split_direction = FALSE)  # 3. Network analysis net_results <- run_comparison_networks(   go_list     = go_results,   de_list     = de_results,   comp_label  = "Car_vs_Bleo",   base_outdir = "results/" )  # 3b. Extract the GO results with clustering for (i in names(net_results)) {   x <- net_results[[i]]$go_term_df   cluster <- gsub("/", "_", i)   name <- paste0(cluster, "_cluster_membership.csv")   write.csv(x, file = paste0(outputDir, "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo/networks/", name)) }  # 4. Word clouds write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork(   net_list   = net_results,   outputDir  = "results/",   comparison = "Car_vs_Bleo" )  # 5. Inspect a specific cluster ecm_terms <- write_cluster_results(   net_result = net_results[["Fibroblast_1"]],   go_term    = "extracellular matrix organization",   outdir     = "results/Car_vs_Bleo/networks/" )

title: GDSCtools: Genomic Data Science Utilities for the Genomic Data Science Core — GDSCtools-package
text: Utility functions downstream single-cell RNA-seq analysis, including cluster-specific differential expression testing via Seurat, Gene Ontology -representation analysis via clusterProfiler, Jaccard- overlap network construction Leiden community detection via igraph, word cloud visualization network cluster themes via ggwordcloud. Designed use 10x Genomics Flex datasets processed Seurat pipeline.

what: Build Network Input Data from GO Enrichment and DE Results — build_network_inputs
title: Build Network Input Data from GO Enrichment and DE Results — build_network_inputs
text: Extracts significant GO terms (adjusted p-value < 0.05) enrichResult object pairs fold-change information differential-expression table. output list containing: (1) named list gene-set members (collection), (2) data frame mean log2 fold-changes per pathway (results_set), (3) unique set DE genes (de_genes). three components required inputs generate_overlap_network.

title: Build Network Input Data from GO Enrichment and DE Results — build_network_inputs
code: build_network_inputs(ego, de_df)

title: Build Network Input Data from GO Enrichment and DE Results — build_network_inputs
text: ego enrichResult object (coercible via .data.frame) produced clusterProfiler::enrichGO similar ORA function. Must contain columns Description, p.adjust, geneID (slash-delimited gene symbols). de_df data frame differentially expressed genes least columns gene avg_log2FC.

title: Build Network Input Data from GO Enrichment and DE Results — build_network_inputs
text: list three elements: collection Named list character vectors; element contains gene symbols associated one GO term. results_set Data frame one row per GO term single column avg_log2FC giving mean fold-change DE genes term's gene set. de_genes Character vector unique DE gene symbols. Returns NULL significant terms pass filtering.

what: Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering — generate_overlap_network
title: Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering — generate_overlap_network
text: Constructs undirected, weighted network nodes enriched GO terms edge weights Jaccard overlap coefficients DE gene sets. Edges overlap_threshold removed. Leiden community detection applied identify clusters functionally related terms. function produces two PNG plots (plain /-regulation view Leiden-clustered view) exports CSV summaries node-level cluster-level statistics.

title: Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering — generate_overlap_network
code: generate_overlap_network(   results_set,   collection,   de_genes,   collection_name = "network",   overlap_threshold = 0.1,   leiden_resolution = 0.03,   outdir = NULL,   plot_to_screen = TRUE,   file_stem = NULL )

title: Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering — generate_overlap_network
text: results_set Data frame row names equal GO term descriptions least one column avg_log2FC (mean fold-change across member genes). collection Named list character vectors. element set gene symbols belonging one GO term. Names must match rownames(results_set). de_genes Character vector differentially expressed gene symbols. Gene sets collection intersected vector computing overlaps. collection_name Character label used plot titles console output. Typically formatted "<comparison>_<celltype>" (e.g., "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo_Fibroblast_1"). overlap_threshold Numeric [0, 1]. Jaccard coefficient edges set zero. Default 0.1. leiden_resolution Numeric. Resolution parameter igraph::cluster_leiden. Default 0.03. outdir Character path output directory. NULL, files written. directory created exist. plot_to_screen Logical. TRUE (default), Leiden- clustered network also drawn active graphics device (e.g., RStudio Plots pane). file_stem Character string used filename prefix exported files. NULL empty, collection_name used.

title: Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering — generate_overlap_network
text: list six elements: network igraph graph object vertex attributes fc, regulation, size, cluster, color, shape. clustering communities object returned igraph::cluster_leiden. overlap_matrix Square numeric matrix pairwise Jaccard coefficients (thresholding). go_term_df Data frame columns go_term, cluster, degree, regulation, avg_log2FC, leiden_resolution. cluster_stats Data frame columns cluster, avg_degree, n_terms. leiden_resolution resolution value used.

title: Generate a Jaccard-Overlap Network of GO Terms with Leiden Clustering — generate_overlap_network
text: outdir non-NULL, following files written: <file_stem>_network_summary.csv – node/edge/cluster counts. <file_stem>-cluster-stats.csv – per-cluster average degree. <file_stem>-plain.png – network coloured regulation direction (red = , blue = ). <file_stem>-clustered-leiden.png – network coloured Leiden cluster membership.

what: Run Cluster-Specific Differential Expression Analysis — run_cluster_de
title: Run Cluster-Specific Differential Expression Analysis — run_cluster_de
text: Performs differential expression two sample identities within specified cell-type cluster using Seurat::FindMarkers. Results filtered adjusted p-value absolute log2 fold-change thresholds, annotated regulation-direction label.

title: Run Cluster-Specific Differential Expression Analysis — run_cluster_de
code: run_cluster_de(   obj,   clusters,   cluster_col = "final_celltype",   ident_col = "sample",   ident1,   ident2,   min.pct = 0.25,   padj_thresh = 0.05,   logfc_thresh = 0.5 )

title: Run Cluster-Specific Differential Expression Analysis — run_cluster_de
text: obj Seurat object containing RNA assay metadata columns specified cluster_col ident_col. clusters Character vector cluster names (values cluster_col metadata column) iterate . cluster_col Character string naming metadata column holds cell-type cluster assignments. Default "final_celltype". ident_col Character string naming metadata column set active identity DE comparison (e.g., "sample", "condition"). Default "sample". ident1 Character string. first identity level (numerator log fold-change calculation). Positive fold-changes indicate genes -regulated ident1. ident2 Character string. second identity level (denominator). min.pct Numeric. Minimum fraction cells either group must express gene tested. Passed Seurat::FindMarkers. Default 0.25. padj_thresh Numeric. Maximum adjusted p-value gene retained filtered output. Default 0.05. logfc_thresh Numeric. Minimum absolute log2 fold-change gene retained. Default 0.5.

title: Run Cluster-Specific Differential Expression Analysis — run_cluster_de
text: named list data frames (one per cluster). data frame contains standard FindMarkers columns plus: gene Gene symbol (row names). cluster cluster label. comparison String "<ident1>_vs_<ident2>". res Direction label: "Upregulated <ident1>" "Upregulated <ident2>".

title: Run Cluster-Specific Differential Expression Analysis — run_cluster_de
text: function subsets Seurat object cluster, sets active identity ident_col, runs Seurat::FindMarkers(assay = "RNA"). frequency table regulation direction printed cluster.

what: Run GO-ORA Overlap Networks for All Clusters in a Comparison — run_comparison_networks
title: Run GO-ORA Overlap Networks for All Clusters in a Comparison — run_comparison_networks
text: Iterates every cluster named list GO enrichment results, builds Jaccard-overlap network enriched GO terms, applies Leiden community detection, saves network plots summary tables. Clusters lack enrichment results fewer two significant pathways skipped message.

title: Run GO-ORA Overlap Networks for All Clusters in a Comparison — run_comparison_networks
code: run_comparison_networks(   go_list,   de_list,   comp_label,   base_outdir,   overlap_threshold = 0.1,   leiden_resolution = 0.03 )

title: Run GO-ORA Overlap Networks for All Clusters in a Comparison — run_comparison_networks
text: go_list named list enrichResult objects (clusterProfiler::enrichGO), one per cell-type cluster. Names must match names de_list. de_list named list differential-expression data frames, one per cluster. data frame must contain least columns gene (gene symbol) avg_log2FC. comp_label Character string identifying comparison (e.g., "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo"). Used build output sub-directory paths prefix plot titles. base_outdir Character path root output directory. sub-directory <comp_label>/networks/ created automatically. overlap_threshold Numeric [0, 1]. Minimum Jaccard overlap two GO term gene sets required draw edge. Default 0.1. leiden_resolution Numeric. Resolution parameter passed igraph::cluster_leiden. Lower values produce fewer, larger communities. Default 0.03.

title: Run GO-ORA Overlap Networks for All Clusters in a Comparison — run_comparison_networks
text: named list network result lists (one per cluster produced valid network). element list returned generate_overlap_network.

what: Run Gene Ontology Over-Representation Analysis on Multiple DEG Sets — run_go_ora
title: Run Gene Ontology Over-Representation Analysis on Multiple DEG Sets — run_go_ora
text: Performs GO enrichment analysis cluster-specific DEG list using clusterProfiler::enrichGO. Produces QC summary table tested versus retained gene sets per cluster.

title: Run Gene Ontology Over-Representation Analysis on Multiple DEG Sets — run_go_ora
code: run_go_ora(   de_list,   org_db,   universe = universe,   keyType = "SYMBOL",   qvalueCutoff = 0.1,   ont = "bp",   outputDir = NULL,   outname = "GO_ORA_QC_summary.csv" )

title: Run Gene Ontology Over-Representation Analysis on Multiple DEG Sets — run_go_ora
text: de_list named list data frames, containing least column gene gene symbols. Typically output run_cluster_de. org_db OrgDb annotation object (e.g., org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db mouse, org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db human). universe Character vector background gene symbols representing genes tested differential expression analysis. Defines enrichment universe. keyType Character string specifying gene identifier type. Default "SYMBOL". qvalueCutoff Numeric. q-value (BH-adjusted p-value) threshold retaining enriched terms. Default 0.1. ont Character string specifying GO sub-ontology test: "BP" (Biological Process), "MF" (Molecular Function), "CC" (Cellular Component), "". Default "bp". outputDir Character path directory QC summary CSV written. Created exist. outname Character filename QC summary CSV. Default "GO_ORA_QC_summary.csv".

title: Run Gene Ontology Over-Representation Analysis on Multiple DEG Sets — run_go_ora
text: named list enrichResult objects (one per cluster). Elements NULL clusters DEGs. QC summary CSV also written <outputDir>/<outname>.

title: Run Gene Ontology Over-Representation Analysis on Multiple DEG Sets — run_go_ora
text: cluster, function: Extracts unique gene symbols DE data frame. Calls clusterProfiler::enrichGO minGSSize = 5, maxGSSize = 300, BH adjustment, readable = TRUE. Annotates result cluster name. Prints per-cluster summary tested/retained gene sets.

what: Extract and Export GO Terms from a Specific Leiden Cluster — write_cluster_results
title: Extract and Export GO Terms from a Specific Leiden Cluster — write_cluster_results
text: Given network result object single GO term interest, identifies Leiden cluster term belongs returns (optionally writes) data frame GO terms sharing cluster. useful inspecting biological theme captured particular network community.

title: Extract and Export GO Terms from a Specific Leiden Cluster — write_cluster_results
code: write_cluster_results(net_result, go_term, outdir, label = NULL)

title: Extract and Export GO Terms from a Specific Leiden Cluster — write_cluster_results
text: net_result list returned generate_overlap_network, must contain least element go_term_df. go_term Character string. GO term description look (e.g., "extracellular matrix organization"). Hyphens internally replaced underscores match network node naming conventions. outdir Character path output directory. non-NULL, CSV file written. directory created exist. label Optional character label used output filename. NULL, defaults "cluster-<id>".

title: Extract and Export GO Terms from a Specific Leiden Cluster — write_cluster_results
text: data frame containing GO terms Leiden cluster go_term, columns go_term, cluster, degree, regulation, avg_log2FC, leiden_resolution. Returns NULL warning requested term found network.

what: Generate Patchwork Word Clouds for All Leiden Clusters — write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork
title: Generate Patchwork Word Clouds for All Leiden Clusters — write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork
text: cell type network result list, function creates multi-panel word cloud figure panel represents one Leiden cluster. GO term labels sized network degree (optionally weighted absolute log2 fold-change) semantically similar terms merged via hierarchical clustering Jaccard distance constituent words. combined figure saved PNG file.

title: Generate Patchwork Word Clouds for All Leiden Clusters — write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork
code: write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork(   net_list,   outputDir,   comparison = "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo",   min_terms = 5,   max_terms = 50,   use_logfc_weight = FALSE,   ncol = 3,   merge_similarity = 0.6 )

title: Generate Patchwork Word Clouds for All Leiden Clusters — write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork
text: net_list named list network result lists, one per cell type. element must list containing least go_term_df (data frame columns go_term, cluster, degree, avg_log2FC), returned generate_overlap_network. outputDir Character path root output directory. Word cloud PNGs saved <outputDir>/<comparison>/networks/. comparison Character string identifying comparison (e.g., "CD206_Car_vs_Bleo"). Used construct output sub-directory. min_terms Integer. Minimum number (post-merge) GO term phrases required generate word cloud cluster. Clusters fewer terms skipped. Default 5. max_terms Integer. Maximum number GO term phrases include per cluster word cloud (sorting weight). Default 50. use_logfc_weight Logical. TRUE, term weights scaled 1 + abs(avg_log2FC), emphasizing terms backed larger fold- changes. Default FALSE. ncol Integer. Number columns patchwork grid layout. Default 3. merge_similarity Numeric [0, 1] NULL. Jaccard- distance threshold merging semantically similar GO term labels. value 0.6 means terms sharing >= 40\ (frequent label kept frequencies summed). Set NULL disable merging. Default 0.6.

title: Generate Patchwork Word Clouds for All Leiden Clusters — write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork
text: Called side effect (writing PNG files). Returns invisible(NULL).

title: Generate Patchwork Word Clouds for All Leiden Clusters — write_cluster_wordclouds_patchwork
text: One PNG per cell type: <outputDir>/<comparison>/networks/<celltype>_all_clusters_wordclouds.png
